selected_hypothesis: Conditional transfers may reallocate a maneuver to a lower-cost operator without violating either operator's original-game outside option. Existing CREAM-style entrepreneurs receive the same options.

dynamics: Circular-reference, small relative perturbation, impulsive Hill-Clohessy-Wiltshire equations in SI. Gaussian uncertainty and bounded execution displacement are supplied assumptions. No atmospheric drag, J2, correlated navigation errors, finite burn, missed commands, unmodeled objects or real maneuver execution is certified.
risk_theorem: For X=mean+Sigma^(1/2) Z with Z standard normal in two dimensions, overlap of a disk radius R after any bounded displacement e implies norm(Z)>=(norm(mean)-R-e)/sqrt(lambda_max(Sigma)). The Rayleigh tail gives exp(-max(0,norm(mean)-R-e)^2/(2 lambda_max)). This is a conservative at-epoch overlap bound, not time-integrated conjunction collision probability.

game.private_information: Actual maneuver costs and asset losses are private types. Initial proposer sees only disclosed quote/type scenarios. A separate participant_response receives private actual costs AFTER the offer and can refuse; proposer never requotes after seeing that response. Three actual B cost types challenge understatement. Binding quotes are assumed authenticated and enforceable. Truthful revelation is NOT established.
game.timing: observe current modeled state, disclose finite quotes/caps, calculate quote-game pure-strategy equilibria, propose contract, each participant checks its own actual type and may refuse before execution or payment, require current cash for fuel/positive transfer/fee, qualify modeled design, conditional choice. A known execution-default case refuses. No real agreement or finance is executed.
game.outside_options: Each participant receives its most favorable cost among enumerated original-game pure Nash outcomes; if no pure equilibrium, refuse instead of inventing a mixed solution. Competent conventional coordinator gets identical transfer/action opportunities.
game.solution_concept: Enumerate finite quote-grid contracts and choose minimum summed declared participant cost subject to quote-based weak individual rationality, modeled risk and cash feasibility; gap zero in that finite set. True private participation is checked separately. Not Bayesian incentive compatibility or universal equilibrium.
game.enforcement: Successful transfer/payment assumes enforceable commitments. Withdrawn permission or known default blocks entry; unknown default, legal enforceability and remedies remain unvalidated deployment requirements.

economics: No local ledger. Root canonical JournalAccount and adaptive Account own all dated profit/cash/capital simulations; these finite contract outputs are conditional technical/economic inputs only.
costs: Measured local CPU and wall time; no incremental spending. Actual assistant tokens and host/model bill unknown. Deployment and commercial costs in COSTS_AND_SOURCES.md are assumptions, never measured wages or market evidence.
independence: Constructor-authored synthetic confirmation seed and inputs frozen before execution, not external physical validation. Separate verifier owns additional cases and does not disclose their truth. Shared-host separation is procedural, not a security boundary.
stopping: Execute exactly registered grid once after parent source freeze; close bounded positive/negative computational stage and report all cases. Correct implementation defects transparently, preserve failed output before any new version. Further physical or commercial claims need a prospectively registered independently validated extension.
